title: SenseFlow SF101 Capri Orange Smart Essential Oil Diffuser

comparisons.notes: Capri Orange-SF101 Set; exact scent + SF101 kit; 46 in stock

writeup: The SenseFlow SF101 Capri Orange is a waterless plug-in essential oil diffuser, new for $9.99. It covers up to 1000 square feet, and the 30ml refill lasts up to 120 days. SenseFlow's site has the same Capri Orange SF101 set in stock at $35.99, so this is 72% and about $26 below the brand's current price. Woot showed 5 or more left, with a limit of 5 per customer.
